subject: Expansion: onboarding 3 new product teams + API key governance
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@brightpath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expanding Redwood across teams — pricing + key governance

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the pilot with the Data Science team and the results look promising — latency and cost profile are within our expectations. We have two follow-ups from leadership:

- We want to onboard three additional internal product teams over Q3 (Search, Recommendations, and Email Assist).
- Each team will need separate API keys, scoped rate limits, and a plan for key rotation and owner assignment.
- Procurement will need a clear one‑page pricing summary and an indicative SOW to discuss internally.

Can Redwood provide an estimate for incremental committed capacity (monthly token commit) and any volume discount tiers? Also please include what security artifacts (SOC 2, encryption, KMS) we can share with Procurement.

Attaching the internal rollout plan (attached: brightpath_rollout_v1.xlsx) for context.

Best,
Samira
Director, AI Platform
BrightPath Labs

Attachments: brightpath_rollout_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@brightpath.ai>, Mason Cole <mason.cole@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across teams — pricing + key governance

Hi Samira — great to hear the pilot went well.

Summary of what we can provide and next steps:

1) API key / governance
- We will provision 3 dedicated API keys (one per team) under the same account with per-key usage quotas and owner fields.
- Support key rotation cadence (90/180 days) and automated revocation hooks.

2) Capacity and pricing (high level)
- Recommended incremental commit: 250M tokens/month to cover initial rollout across 3 teams with a modest ramp.
- Volume tiers: 0–500M, 500M–2B, 2B+. Pricing and marginal unit discount improves at each tier; I attached a one‑page estimate.

3) Security artifacts
- We can share our redacted SOC 2 report, KMS integration checklist, and network diagrams for the Private deployment.

Next steps:
- I can draft an SOW and a short invoice-friendly summary for Procurement.
- Can you confirm expected go‑live window (target month) and whether any team requires Private/VPC deployment vs hosted?

Attaching: BrightPath_MultiTeam_Estimate_May2026.pdf (cost summary)

If it helps I’ll loop in Rishi and Vivek internally to finalize capacity and roll-out timing.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightPath_MultiTeam_Estimate_May2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightPath expansion — technical & pricing ask

Rishi / Vivek — following Samira's note (below). Need a quick alignment on the numbers and a recommended ramp. High level asks:

- Confirm that 250M tokens/month is a reasonable starting commit for three teams (Search/Rec/Email Assist). If not, propose an alternative commit and an expected 90‑day ramp.
- Estimate Dedicated pool requirement if they opt for reserved capacity instead of hosted (GPU count approximation).
- Any caveats around per-key rate limiting or KV cache isolation we should call out for performance-sensitive workloads.
- Suggest a short line item (one-time) for onboarding and key governance setup.

I’ve attached the one‑pager estimate. Hoping to get your notes by EOD so I can send the SOW + quote to Procurement.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachments: BrightPath_MultiTeam_Estimate_May2026.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:17:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: BrightPath expansion — technical & pricing ask

Quick notes, high level:

- 250M tokens/month is fine as an initial committed baseline for a staggered rollout. Expect ~15–25% week-over-week ramp in first 8–12 weeks per team depending on usage patterns.
- If Customer chooses Dedicated: recommend 2x A40 nodes initially (or 1x A100 private pod) with autoscaling to handle spikes — estimated sustained throughput ~12–18k tokens/sec aggregate.
- Per-key governance: we support per-key soft quotas and per-route rate limits. For strict isolation we can map each key to a tenant-specific cache; there is a one-time setup (~8 hrs of eng time).
- Onboarding line item: $6,500 flat for governance mapping, SSO/KMS integration assistance, and runbook handoff.

I also recommend offering a 7% commit discount for their first 12 months given they are expanding multiple teams (helps bridge procurement conversations).

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Report_redacted.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@brightpath.ai>, Mason Cole <mason.cole@brightpath.ai>, procurement@brightpath.ai
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across teams — pricing + key governance

Hi Samira / Mason / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Per internal alignment: 

- Proposal: 250M tokens/month initial commit, 7% introductory commit discount for months 1–12, and a one‑time $6,500 onboarding fee for key governance + integrations.
- We will provision 3 named API keys, per-key quotas, and an automated rotation playbook.
- If you require Dedicated, we estimate 2 A40 nodes and will provide a formal quote for that deployment.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and a short pricing summary for Procurement to review. Please confirm:
1) Procurement contact for PO and billing terms (net30/45)
2) Target go-live month for the first team (Search) so we can schedule onboarding resources

Next: I’ll create a DocuSign envelope for the SOW once Procurement confirms billing contact and terms.

Attachments: BP_SOW_Draft_May2026.docx (docx), BrightPath_MultiTeam_Estimate_May2026.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

From: Mason Cole <mason.cole@brightpath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Samira Patel <samira@brightpath.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expanding Redwood across teams — pricing + key governance

Soojin,

Thanks — Procurement confirmed they can take this to legal next week. A few quick answers:

- Billing contact: finance@brightpath.ai, net30 preferred.
- Target go-live for Search: 2026-08-01 (we want a 6–8 week onboarding window).
- Dedicated vs Hosted: we will start hosted; we may evaluate Dedicated later in Q4.

Can you send the DocuSign link and a kickoff calendar invite for the week of June 14? Also include the onboarding runbook and the list of technical owners we should expect from Redwood.

Thanks,
Mason Cole
VP, Engineering | BrightPath Labs
